note: Later-round files built on top of the v1 splits. Hashes are of the exact published bytes. All rows are synthetic. There is zero family, group or exact-message overlap with validation, calibration or test, but rows added in rounds 2-4 were written after earlier errors (including test-split errors) had been inspected, and some are close template neighbours of evaluation rows. See eval/README.md.

data/train_v2.jsonl.description: Round 2 training set: the 240 v1 training rows plus 160 synthetic rows (V2_*).

data/train_v3.jsonl.description: Round 3 training set: train_v2 plus 120 synthetic rows (V3_*).

data/train_v4.jsonl.description: Round 4 training set: train_v3 plus 200 synthetic rows (V4_*).

data/calibration_v4.jsonl.description: Calibration set used to fit the v4 temperature: the 40 v1 calibration rows plus 20 synthetic rows (CAL_*).

data/blind_test_v4.jsonl.description: 20-row synthetic set (10 bilingual scenarios) evaluated once with v4; has template neighbours in train_v4, so it is a regression check, not an independent test.
